meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 5 — Environmental / land-use / climate layer and digital-economy statistics. Links palm-oil and resource expansion to forest cover, deforestation, GHG inventories, and adds the official e-commerce statistical product.

candidates.title: Forest cover and land-cover statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Forestry / BPS related / official monitoring
candidates.description: Official monitoring of forested land area (recent figures around 95.5 million ha / ~51 % of land area). Primary quantitative measure of remaining forest stock inside and outside formal forest areas.
candidates.notes: Stock-side environmental node that pairs with the flow (deforestation) series.

candidates.title: Deforestation rate statistics (gross and net)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Forestry / BPS (historical tables) / official satellite monitoring
candidates.description: Annual gross and net deforestation figures (e.g. net ~175 thousand ha in recent monitoring). Broken down by forest type and inside/outside forest area. Continuously cited in environmental, commodity and climate policy.
candidates.notes: High-visibility environmental flow node. Direct edge into the palm-oil and land-use clusters.

candidates.title: Greenhouse-gas inventory and physical supply-use for emissions
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Environment / BPS (physical supply-use tables) / related
candidates.description: National GHG inventory and BPS physical supply-and-use tables for emissions by sector (energy, industry, agriculture, LULUCF, waste, etc.). Underpins NDC accounting and climate-policy analysis.
referenced_by: NDC and long-term climate strategy documents
candidates.notes: Core climate-statistical node. Large LULUCF and energy shares are distinctive for Indonesia.

candidates.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and climate-policy framework
candidates.publisher: Government of Indonesia / Ministry of Environment
candidates.description: Indonesia’s successive NDCs and related long-term climate strategies. Recurring citation frame that organises emissions targets, LULUCF commitments and energy-transition language.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame node for the climate cluster.

candidates.title: E-Commerce Statistics
candidates.description: Annual BPS survey-based publication on e-commerce businesses: profiles, workers, activities and transaction values, with provincial estimates. Official statistical window on the digital commercial economy.
candidates.notes: Key digital-economy statistical product from BPS.

candidates.title: Digital-economy and ICT indicators (broader)
candidates.description: Broader official indicators of internet access, digital adoption, ICT sector contribution and related metrics that contextualise the e-commerce statistics within the wider digital transformation agenda.
candidates.notes: Umbrella digital node surrounding the e-commerce survey.

candidates.title: Land-use and land-cover change statistics linked to agriculture and estates
candidates.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Forestry / Ministry of Agriculture related
candidates.description: Statistics and monitoring products that track conversion of forest and other land into agricultural and estate-crop uses (especially palm oil). Forms the land-use bridge between commodity expansion and deforestation/GHG outcomes.
candidates.notes: Explicit land-use edge connecting the commodity and environmental clusters.

candidates.title: Reforestation / forest and land rehabilitation statistics
candidates.description: Official figures on forest and land rehabilitation (reforestation) area, used as the offset in net-deforestation calculations and as a policy-performance indicator.

candidates.title: Broader environmental statistics (water, waste, air — where published by BPS or ministries)
candidates.description: Additional environmental statistical products covering water resources, waste, air quality and related indicators that complement the forest and GHG core.

candidates.title: Indonesia environment–climate–digital meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Forestry, BPS, Environment ministry and digital statistics
candidates.description: Meta-node that binds forest cover, deforestation, reforestation, land-use change, GHG inventory, NDC framework, e-commerce and broader digital indicators into a coherent environment-and-digital layer, with explicit edges into the commodity (palm oil) and spatial clusters.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Palm-oil, energy and provincial series from earlier batches
